fact.zh: 兩個氫原子手牽手,是宇宙中最輕的氣體。
fact.en: Two hydrogen atoms holding hands: the lightest gas of all.

use.zh: 燃料電池車的燃料,燃燒後只會變成水!
use.en: Fuel-cell car fuel. It burns into plain water!

fact.zh: 兩個氧原子用「雙鍵」抓得緊緊的。
fact.en: Two oxygen atoms joined by a double bond.

use.zh: 我們每一口呼吸都需要它,火也需要它才會燃燒。
use.en: Every breath needs it, and fire needs it to burn.

fact.zh: 三個氧原子彎彎的排在一起,有一點特別的味道。
fact.en: Three oxygen atoms in a bent shape, with a sharp smell.

use.zh: 高空的臭氧層像大雨傘,幫我們擋住太陽的紫外線。
use.en: The ozone layer is a giant umbrella blocking the Sun's UV rays.

fact.zh: 兩個氮原子用「三鍵」緊緊相連,非常穩定。
fact.en: Two nitrogen atoms joined by a very strong triple bond.

use.zh: 佔空氣的 78%;洋芋片包裝充氮氣,可以保持酥脆。
use.en: 78% of air. Chip bags are filled with it to stay crunchy.

fact.zh: 一個氧原子加兩個氫原子,像一張小小的笑臉。
fact.en: One oxygen and two hydrogens, like a tiny smiley face.

use.zh: 生命的泉源!我們身體約有 60% 是水。
use.en: The source of life! About 60% of your body is water.

howto.zh: 拼法:先把 2 個 O 牽在一起,再在每個 O 上各牽 1 個 H。
howto.en: Build: join 2 O atoms, then attach 1 H to each O.

fact.zh: 比水多一個氧原子。
fact.en: Water with one extra oxygen.

use.zh: 稀釋後可以幫傷口消毒、漂白衣服(請大人幫忙使用)。
use.en: Diluted, it disinfects and bleaches (ask a grown-up).

howto.zh: 拼法:讓 1 個 C 在中間,左右各牽 1 個 O(每個 O 會用兩隻手抓緊 C)。
howto.en: Build: put 1 C in the middle with 1 O on each side. Each O grips C with two hands.

fact.zh: 一個碳原子抱著兩個氧原子,排成一直線。
fact.en: A carbon atom holding two oxygens in a straight line.

use.zh: 汽水的氣泡就是它!植物也用它來做光合作用。
use.en: The bubbles in soda! Plants use it for photosynthesis.

fact.zh: 燃燒不完全時會產生,無色無味但有毒。
fact.en: Made when fuel burns incompletely. Colorless, odorless and poisonous.

use.zh: 使用瓦斯熱水器要保持通風,避免中毒。
use.en: Keep rooms ventilated when using gas heaters.

howto.zh: 拼法:把 3 個 H 都牽在 1 個 N 上。
howto.en: Build: attach 3 H atoms to 1 N.

fact.zh: 一個氮原子加三個氫原子,像一座小金字塔。
fact.en: A nitrogen with three hydrogens, shaped like a little pyramid.

use.zh: 用來製造肥料,味道很刺鼻。
use.en: Used to make fertilizer. It has a sharp smell.

howto.zh: 拼法:把 4 個 H 都牽在 1 個 C 上。
howto.en: Build: attach 4 H atoms to 1 C.

fact.zh: 一個碳原子被四個氫原子圍住,形狀像小金字塔(正四面體)。
fact.en: A carbon surrounded by four hydrogens in a tetrahedron.

use.zh: 天然氣的主要成分,家裡煮飯的瓦斯就是它。
use.en: The main part of natural gas, used for cooking.

fact.zh: 溶在水裡就是鹽酸,我們的胃液裡也有它!
fact.en: Dissolved in water it is hydrochloric acid, which is also in your stomach!

use.zh: 幫助胃消化食物(濃度很低);工廠用來清除鐵鏽。
use.en: Helps digest food; factories use it to remove rust.

fact.zh: 鈉和氯整齊地交錯排列成方塊晶體。
fact.en: Sodium and chlorine alternate in a neat cubic crystal.

use.zh: 每天的調味料。鈉遇水會爆炸,氯有毒,結合後卻很安全!
use.en: Our everyday seasoning. Sodium and chlorine are dangerous alone, yet safe together!

howto.zh: 拼法:先把 2 個 C 牽在一起。第一個 C 再牽 3 個 H;第二個 C 牽 2 個 H 和 1 個 O;最後把 1 個 H 牽在 O 上。
howto.en: Build: join 2 C atoms. Give the first C 3 H. Give the second C 2 H and 1 O. Finally attach 1 H to the O.

fact.zh: 碳、氫、氧三種原子一起組成。
fact.en: Built from carbon, hydrogen and oxygen.

use.zh: 酒精消毒液可以殺死細菌(兒童不能喝含酒精飲料)。
use.en: Rubbing alcohol kills germs.

howto.zh: 拼法:1) 先把 2 個 C 牽在一起。2) 左邊的 C 牽 3 個 H。3) 右邊的 C 牽 2 個 O。4) 其中一個 O 再牽 1 個 H,沒牽 H 的那個 O 會自動用兩隻手抓緊 C。
howto.en: Build: 1) Join 2 C atoms. 2) Give the left C 3 H. 3) Attach 2 O atoms to the right C. 4) Attach 1 H to one of those O atoms. The O without H grips C with two hands.

fact.zh: 食用醋酸酸的味道就是它。
fact.en: The sour taste of vinegar.

use.zh: 廚房的醋,可以拿來調味、清除水垢。
use.en: Kitchen vinegar for seasoning and cleaning limescale.

howto.zh: 拼法:先把 3 個 C 排成一排牽起來。兩端的 C 各牽 3 個 H,中間的 C 牽 2 個 H。
howto.en: Build: join 3 C atoms in a row. Give each end C 3 H and the middle C 2 H.

fact.zh: 三個碳排成一排,身上穿著八件氫外套。
fact.en: Three carbons in a row wearing eight hydrogens.

use.zh: 桶裝瓦斯、露營瓦斯爐的燃料。
use.en: Fuel for gas bottles and camping stoves.

howto.zh: 拼法:先讓 C 在中間,牽上 3 個 O。再把 H 牽在其中一個 O 上,Na 牽在另一個 O 上,最後一個 O 不用再牽別人。
howto.en: How to build: put C in the middle and attach 3 O atoms. Then attach H to one O and Na to another O. The last O stays as it is.

fact.zh: 白色粉末,遇到酸會冒出氣泡。
fact.en: A white powder that fizzes with acid.

use.zh: 做蛋糕、饅頭讓麵團膨起來,也能去除異味。
use.en: Makes cakes rise and removes odors.

fact.zh: 雞蛋殼、貝殼、珍珠、石灰岩都是它。
fact.en: Eggshells, seashells, pearls and limestone.

use.zh: 補鈣片、粉筆、水泥的原料。
use.en: Calcium tablets, chalk and cement.

fact.zh: 火山和燃燒煤炭會產生的刺鼻氣體。
fact.en: A sharp gas released by volcanoes and burning coal.

use.zh: 是造成酸雨的原因之一,所以要減少汙染。
use.en: A cause of acid rain, so we should cut pollution.

howto.zh: 拼法:讓 1 個 N 在中間,左右各牽 1 個 O。N 會剩下一隻手空著,這是正常的!
howto.en: Build: put 1 N in the middle with 1 O on each side. N keeps one hand free - that is normal!

fact.zh: 棕黃色的氣體。它有一隻手永遠牽不滿,所以特別活潑、容易跟別人反應!
fact.en: A brown gas. One of its hands can never be filled, so it is very active!

use.zh: 汽車廢氣和工廠排放的空氣汙染物,是霧霾的原因之一。
use.en: A pollutant from car exhaust and factories that adds to smog.

fact.zh: 植物用陽光、水和二氧化碳做出來的糖。
fact.en: The sugar plants make from sunlight, water and CO2.

use.zh: 是我們身體和大腦的能量來源。
use.en: The energy source for your body and brain.

fact.zh: 每個碳都跟四個碳手牽手,排成立體網格,所以超級硬。
fact.en: Each carbon holds four others in a 3D grid, so it is super hard.

use.zh: 閃亮的寶石,也用來切割堅硬的東西。
use.en: Sparkling gems, and cutting tools for hard stuff.

fact.zh: 碳排成一層一層的蜂巢,層與層很容易滑開。
fact.en: Carbon in honeycomb sheets that slide over each other.

use.zh: 鉛筆寫字時,一層層的石墨就留在紙上。
use.en: When you write, layers of graphite stay on the paper.

fact.zh: 鐵碰到水和空氣慢慢變成的紅褐色粉末。
fact.en: The red-brown powder iron slowly turns into with water and air.

use.zh: 鐵製品生鏽就是它,也用來做紅色顏料。
use.en: What rust is made of; also a red pigment.

fact.zh: 氫和氟牽手,溶在水裡會變成能蝕刻玻璃的氫氟酸。
fact.en: Hydrogen holds hands with fluorine. In water it etches glass.

use.zh: 用來在玻璃上蝕刻花紋,需要大人在實驗室使用。
use.en: Used to etch glass, only by experts.

fact.zh: 紅棕色的液體,會冒出刺鼻的煙。
fact.en: A red-brown liquid that gives off sharp fumes.

use.zh: 用來製造藥品和阻燃劑。
use.en: Used to make medicines and flame retardants.

fact.zh: 紫黑色的晶體,加熱會直接變成紫色氣體。
fact.en: Purple-black crystals that turn straight into purple gas.

use.zh: 碘酒可以幫傷口消毒;身體需要一點點碘才能製造甲狀腺素。
use.en: Iodine tincture cleans wounds; your body needs a little iodine.

fact.zh: 很多這種小單元連成長長的鏈子,就是鐵氟龍,超級滑。
fact.en: Many of these units join into a long chain called Teflon - super slippery.

use.zh: 不沾鍋的塗層,煎蛋不會黏。
use.en: The coating of non-stick pans.

fact.zh: 很強的鹼,會讓皮膚受傷,要小心。
fact.en: A strong base that can hurt skin.

use.zh: 製作肥皂、通水管的原料(請大人使用)。
use.en: Used to make soap and unblock drains (adults only).

fact.zh: 漂白水的主要成分,可以殺死細菌。
fact.en: The main part of bleach, which kills germs.

use.zh: 消毒、漂白衣服(不能和別的清潔劑混在一起)。
use.en: Disinfecting and bleaching (never mix with other cleaners).

fact.zh: 非常強的酸,會腐蝕東西,絕對不能亂碰。
fact.en: A very strong acid that eats away materials.

use.zh: 汽車電池裡有它,工廠也用它做肥料。
use.en: Found in car batteries and used to make fertilizer.

fact.zh: 磷在中間,抓著四個氧,其中三個還帶著氫。
fact.en: Phosphorus holds four oxygens, three of them carrying hydrogens.

use.zh: 可樂的酸味來源,也用在肥料裡。
use.en: Gives cola its tang and goes into fertilizer.

fact.zh: 四個磷原子排成小金字塔。很容易著火,要泡在水裡保存。
fact.en: Four phosphorus atoms in a tiny pyramid. It catches fire easily.

use.zh: 磷是火柴頭的原料,也是骨頭和 DNA 需要的元素。
use.en: Phosphorus is in match heads, bones and DNA.

fact.zh: 八個硫原子連成皺皺的皇冠環,是黃色粉末。
fact.en: Eight sulfur atoms in a crown-shaped ring: a yellow powder.

use.zh: 溫泉的味道、火柴和火藥都有它。
use.en: Found at hot springs, in matches and fireworks.

fact.zh: 沙子、水晶和玻璃的主要成分。
fact.en: The main part of sand, quartz and glass.

use.zh: 蓋房子的玻璃、水晶球都是它。
use.en: Window glass and crystal balls.

fact.zh: 超級白的粉末,會擋住紫外線。
fact.en: A super-white powder that blocks UV light.

use.zh: 白色顏料和防曬乳。
use.en: White paint and sunscreen.

fact.zh: 透明又能導電的神奇材料。
fact.en: A clear material that can carry electricity.

use.zh: 觸控螢幕和太陽能板的透明導電層。
use.en: The transparent conductor in touchscreens.

fact.zh: 黑色的陶瓷小顆粒,裡面藏著很大的能量。
fact.en: Small black ceramic pellets full of energy.

use.zh: 核能發電廠的燃料(有輻射,只有專家處理)。
use.en: Nuclear power fuel, handled only by experts.

fact.zh: 混進一點別的金屬,就變成紅寶石或藍寶石。
fact.en: A pinch of another metal turns it into ruby or sapphire.

use.zh: 寶石、砂紙的磨料,鋁表面的保護膜也是它。
use.en: Gems, sandpaper grit and the skin on aluminium.

fact.zh: 白色的小晶體,泡在水裡很好溶解。
fact.en: Small white crystals that dissolve in water.

use.zh: 泡腳的浴鹽、植物的鎂肥。
use.en: Bath salts and plant fertilizer.

fact.zh: 美麗的藍色晶體,溶在水裡整杯水都變藍。
fact.en: Beautiful blue crystals that turn water blue.

use.zh: 科學實驗長晶體、農場殺菌(有毒,不能吃)。
use.en: Growing crystals and farm fungicide (poisonous!).

fact.zh: 白色粉末,是做鋰電池的重要原料。
fact.en: A white powder, key for making lithium batteries.

use.zh: 手機、電動車的鋰電池。
use.en: Phone and electric-car batteries.

fact.zh: 白色晶體,含有植物最愛的鉀和氮。
fact.en: White crystals with the potassium and nitrogen plants love.

use.zh: 肥料,也是煙火的材料。
use.en: Fertilizer and an ingredient in fireworks.

fact.zh: 鈉和氟配成一對。
fact.en: A sodium and a fluorine pair.

use.zh: 牙膏裡的氟,幫牙齒抵抗蛀蟲。
use.en: The fluoride in toothpaste that protects teeth.

fact.zh: 像食鹽,不過是鉀和氯配成對。
fact.en: Like salt, but with potassium.

use.zh: 代用鹽、植物肥料。
use.en: Salt substitute and fertilizer.

fact.zh: 鉀和碘配成一對。
fact.en: A potassium and an iodine pair.

use.zh: 加碘鹽裡的碘,幫身體製造甲狀腺素。
use.en: The iodine in iodized salt.

fact.zh: 白色粉末,照到光會慢慢變黑。
fact.en: A white powder that slowly darkens in light.

use.zh: 傳統相片的感光材料。
use.en: Used in old photo paper.

fact.zh: 照到光就會起變化的淡黃色粉末。
fact.en: A pale powder that changes in light.

use.zh: 傳統底片就是靠它拍出照片。
use.en: Old camera film used it to take pictures.

fact.zh: 鎂在空氣中燃燒,發出刺眼白光後變成的白色粉末。
fact.en: The white ash left when magnesium burns with a dazzling light.

use.zh: 耐高溫的爐子材料、運動員手上的白粉。
use.en: Heat-proof furnace lining and climbers' chalk.

fact.zh: 加水會發熱,冒出熱氣。
fact.en: Adds heat when water is added.

use.zh: 食品乾燥劑,蓋房子也用得到。
use.en: Food drying packs and building.

fact.zh: 白色粉末,可以擋住紫外線。每個鋅被 4 個氧圍成小金字塔(纖鋅礦結構)。
fact.en: A white powder that blocks UV. Each zinc sits inside a tetrahedron of 4 oxygens (wurtzite).

use.zh: 防曬乳、嬰兒痱子粉。
use.en: Sunscreen and baby powder.

fact.zh: 黃色或紅色的粉末,有毒。
fact.en: A yellow or red powder. Poisonous.

use.zh: 做鉛玻璃和舊式電池,現在盡量少用。
use.en: Lead glass and old batteries; use is shrinking.

fact.zh: 鮮紅色的礦石。
fact.en: A bright red mineral.

use.zh: 古時候的紅色顏料(有毒)。
use.en: Ancient red pigment (poisonous).

fact.zh: 比鋼鐵還硬很多。碳被 6 個鎢圍成三角柱(六方結構)。
fact.en: Much harder than steel. Each carbon sits in a trigonal prism of 6 tungsten atoms.

use.zh: 超硬的鑽頭和刀具,原子筆筆尖。
use.en: Tough drill bits, cutters and ballpoint tips.

fact.zh: 只有一顆原子的氣體,不跟別人牽手。
fact.en: A gas of single atoms that never hold hands.

use.zh: 氣球、冷卻醫院的核磁共振儀。
use.en: Balloons and cooling MRI scanners.

fact.zh: 通電會發出紅橘色的光。
fact.en: Glows red-orange with electricity.

use.zh: 霓虹燈招牌。
use.en: Neon signs.

fact.zh: 空氣裡第三多的氣體,非常安靜。
fact.en: The third most common gas in air, very calm.

use.zh: 燈泡裡的保護氣體,不讓燈絲燒壞。
use.en: Protects light-bulb filaments.

fact.zh: 稀少的氣體,會發出白光。
fact.en: A rare gas that glows white.

use.zh: 攝影用的閃光燈。
use.en: Photo flash lamps.

fact.zh: 發出很亮的藍白光。
fact.en: Glows with a bright blue-white light.

use.zh: 汽車的氙氣大燈。
use.en: Xenon car headlights.

fact.zh: 最輕的金屬,輕到可以浮在水上。
fact.en: The lightest metal, floats on water.

use.zh: 手機和電動車的電池。
use.en: Phone and car batteries.

fact.zh: 燃燒時會發出刺眼的白光。
fact.en: Burns with a dazzling white light.

use.zh: 閃光燈、煙火、輕巧的筆電外殼。
use.en: Flash bulbs, fireworks and light laptop cases.

fact.zh: 又輕又不容易生鏽的銀白色金屬。
fact.en: A light, rust-proof silvery metal.

use.zh: 鋁罐、鋁箔、飛機。
use.en: Cans, foil and planes.

fact.zh: 很軟的金屬,遇水會爆出火花。
fact.en: A soft metal that sparks in water.

use.zh: 植物和人體都需要它,香蕉裡也有。
use.en: Plants and people need it; bananas have it.

fact.zh: 像鋼鐵一樣強,卻輕得多。
fact.en: As strong as steel yet much lighter.

use.zh: 眼鏡架、飛機、人工關節。
use.en: Glasses frames, planes and joints.

fact.zh: 銀亮閃閃,不容易生鏽。
fact.en: Shiny and hard to rust.

use.zh: 水龍頭的電鍍,也是不鏽鋼的成員。
use.en: Tap plating and a part of stainless steel.

fact.zh: 可以被磁鐵吸住,潮濕會生鏽。
fact.en: Sticks to magnets; rusts when damp.

use.zh: 鋼鐵蓋房子、造橋樑。
use.en: Steel for buildings and bridges.

fact.zh: 銀白色,也能被磁鐵吸住。
fact.en: Silver-white and a bit magnetic.

use.zh: 硬幣和電池。
use.en: Coins and batteries.

fact.zh: 紅橘色,很會導電和導熱。
fact.en: Reddish and great at carrying electricity and heat.

use.zh: 電線、銅鍋。
use.en: Electric wires and pots.

fact.zh: 藍白色金屬,可以保護鐵不生鏽。
fact.en: A bluish metal that protects iron from rust.

use.zh: 鍍鋅鐵皮、乾電池。
use.en: Galvanized steel and batteries.

fact.zh: 最會導電的金屬,亮晶晶。
fact.en: The best electric conductor, very shiny.

use.zh: 銀飾、餐具。
use.en: Jewelry and cutlery.

fact.zh: 很軟,熔點低,容易融化。
fact.en: Soft and melts easily.

use.zh: 焊錫、馬口鐵罐。
use.en: Solder and tin cans.

fact.zh: 熔點最高的金屬,超級耐熱。
fact.en: The metal with the highest melting point.

use.zh: 舊式燈泡裡的燈絲。
use.en: Old light-bulb filaments.

fact.zh: 銀白、稀有又不容易變色。
fact.en: Rare, silvery and never tarnishes.

use.zh: 白金戒指、汽車廢氣過濾器。
use.en: Rings and car exhaust cleaners.

fact.zh: 金黃色,不會生鏽,很柔軟。
fact.en: Golden, never rusts and very soft.

use.zh: 金飾、電子零件。
use.en: Jewelry and electronics.

fact.zh: 常溫下是液體的金屬,有毒。
fact.en: A metal that is liquid at room temperature. Toxic.

use.zh: 老式溫度計(現在已經少用了)。
use.en: Old thermometers (now rare).

fact.zh: 又重又軟,有毒,不能亂碰。
fact.en: Heavy, soft and toxic.

use.zh: 舊式汽車電池。
use.en: Old car batteries.

fact.zh: 像鑽石一樣排成網格的灰色硬物。
fact.en: A hard grey solid, in a diamond-like grid.

use.zh: 電腦和手機裡的晶片。
use.en: Chips in computers and phones.

fact.zh: 鐵加了鉻,就不容易生鏽。
fact.en: Iron plus chromium resists rust.

use.zh: 鍋子、餐具。
use.en: Pots and cutlery.
